scope: KR new-entry h5 price-return research only; no holding-renewal changes or production promotion

target.entry: top6 and score>0; no replacement from rank7

model.features: existing14 plus existing14 missing indicators; original fold-local preprocessing and clip8
model.sample_weight: N/(D*n_t); average1 and equal total weight per date
model.all_zero_head: constant0, no fit; both zero means no_economic_edge

single_net_tree: same tree parameters/preprocessing/weights, squared_error, target100*net; diagnostic not automatic alternative
ridge14: original alpha0.1 gross Ridge; convert prediction to120bp net for entry, no new bias
settlement_tail: only confirmed cash settlements after flat holdings/zero pending by price tail; through actual final T+2 (latest planned2025-01-03); no later quotes/orders/return extrapolation
account_extra_arm: momentum_same_slots: candidate ex-ante k, ownNAV/6 per slot, no actual-fill feedback; not risk matched
account: initial10000000KRW; phases0..4; ownNAV/6 slots; forced h5 exits including same-name roundtrip; existing integer ExecutionBook/1% buy limit/prior-volume1%/T+2; future open never sets quantity
expiry_queue: preserve cohort/original order ID, initial close decision date, original_due_on (first open attempt including scenario delay), remaining shares and absolute original_due_on+5regular_sessions deadline (initial+5retry); new cohort cannot reset/cancel old exit; cancel same-name new buy while residual remains, no replacement; unfinished volume-capped liquidation -> incomplete; adapter only, common core unchanged

acceptance.base_and_high_cost: each scenario five-phase mean net>0 and mean exceeds ridge14,single_net_tree,momentum12_skip21,momentum_same_slots
acceptance.risk: each base/high cost worst-phase MDD>=-10% and no worse than each basic trading comparator worst-phase MDD
acceptance.stress: each half/delay mean>0 and above ridge14,momentum12_skip21,momentum_same_slots; worst-phase MDD>=-10%
acceptance.concentration: 75bp only: per-name netKRW contribution including fees averaged over5phases, remove highest positive contributor (ticker tie); remaining sum<=0 -> concentrated_support only if other gates pass; not counterfactual account return
acceptance.invalid: time/source/account invariants broken or ledger error>1KRW
acceptance.missing: selected labels or consumed account data unknown -> null; never filter before ranking; incomplete required comparisons -> inconclusive_data unless a complete comparison unit proves required violation
acceptance.success_ceiling: conditional_development_support; internal instability prominently disclosed; no production adoption
acceptance.internal_folds: diagnostic only, no tuning or selection of final settings; preserve original #816 verdict
